```{r ar_mask}
namask <- daice[,
  .(
    mean_na = mean(is.na(aice)),
    mean_ice = mean(aice, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(aice)),
    var = var(aice, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(lon, lat)
]

ar_mask <- namask[mean_na == 0 & var != 0 & mean_ice > 0.1, .(lon, lat)]

```



```{r}
# xtable::xtable(model_monthly, display = rep('g', 5), digits = 2)
```

```{r mask}
mask <- daice[, mean(is.na(aice)), by = .(lon, lat)] |>
  _[V1 < 1] |>
  _[, V1 := NULL]
```


----






```{r mask2}
mask <- daice[, mean(is.na(aice)), by = .(lon, lat)][V1 < 1][, V1 := NULL]
```


```{r sim1}
time_translate <- daice |>
  copy() |>
  _[, t := 0:(.N - 1), by = .(lon, lat)] |>
  _[, .(t, time)] |>
  unique()


times <- seq(0, uniqueN(daice$time) - 1)
start <- daice[time == time[1]] |>
  _[mask, on = .NATURAL]
forcing_temp <- era_temp_fun(daice[start[, .(lon, lat)], on = c("lon", "lat")])
d_ice_fun <- d_ice(coef(model_monthly))

time_fun <- time_translate[, approxfun(t, time)]
# rnorm(length(coef(model_monthly)))
sim1 <- evolve(
  start = start,
  model = d_ice(coef(model_monthly), inflation = 1),
  start_time = min(times),
  end_time = max(times),
  dt = 1 / 31,
  forcing = forcing_temp
) |>
  _[time == as.integer(time)] |>
  _[, time := as.POSIXct(time_fun(time))]
```

```{r forecast}
months <- formatC(1:12, width = 2, flag = "0")
years <- 1982:2024

forecast <- CJ(month = months, year = years) |>
  _[,
    file := glue::glue_data(
      .SD,
      "~/access-s2_ice-eval/data/derived/hindcast/aice/S2/{year}-{month}-01/01.nc"
    )
  ] |>
  _[file.exists(file)] |>
  _[,
    file |>
      cdo_selmonth(as.numeric(month)) |>
      cdo_monmean() |>
      cdo_remapbil(era_grid) |>
      cdo_execute(options = "-s -L"),
    by = .(year, month)
  ] |>
  _[order(year, month)]
```

```{r forecast_data} 
forecast_data <- forecast$V1 |>
  cdo_mergetime() |>
  cdo_setday(1) |>
  cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
  cdo_execute() |>
  ReadNetCDF("aice") |>
  setnames(c("longitude", "latitude"), c("lon", "lat")) |>
  _[mask, on = .NATURAL]
```

```{r sim_obs, include=FALSE}

sim <- rbind(
  sim = sim1[, .(time, lon, lat, value = aice)],
  obs = daice[, .(time, lon, lat, value = aice)],
  S2 = forecast_data[, .(time, lon, lat, value = aice)],
  idcol = "variable"
) |>
  _[year(time) > 1981] |>
  na.omit()
```


## Integrating this model


$$
\frac{dC_{ij}}{dt} = f(C_{ij}, T_{ij})
$$

Where $C_{ij}$ is sea-ice concentration in gridpoint $ij$, $T_{ij}$ is the t2m temperature in gridpoint $ij$ and $f$ is the polynomial fit on monthly values. $T$ comes from ERA5. 

---


```{r mean_aice}
mean_aice <- sim |>
  _[,
    .(mean_aice = weighted.mean(value, w = cos(lat * pi / 180), na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(variable, time)
  ] |>
  _[,
    mean_aice_a := mean_aice - mean(mean_aice, na.rm = TRUE),
    by = .(variable, month(time))
  ]
```


```{r}
labeller_month <- setNames(month.abb, 1:12)
labeller_sims <- setNames(
  c("Observations", "ACCESS-S2", "This model"),
  c("obs", "S2", "sim")
)
```


```{r sim-sd}
sim_sd <- sim |>
  _[variable != "S2"] |>
  _[month(time) %in% c(2, 9)] |>
  _[, sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), by = .(lon, lat, month(time), variable)]
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9.385
#| fig-height: 10.563
#| label: sd-lonlat
range_tanaka
sim_sd |>
  ggperiodic::periodic(lon = c(0, 360)) |>
  _[, month := factor(month)] |>
  _[, variable := factor(variable)] |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_contour_fill(
    aes(z = V1, fill = ..level..),
    proj = proj,
    proj.latlon = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_contour_tanaka(
    aes(z = V1),
    smooth = 2,
    range = range_tanaka,
    proj = proj,
    proj.latlon = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_contour2(data = topo, aes(xgrid, ygrid, z = topo), breaks = 0) +
  as.discretised_scale(scale_fill_viridis_c)(
    "Sea-ice concentration standard deviation"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    month ~ variable,
    labeller = labeller(month = labeller_month, variable = labeller_sims)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  coord_equal() +
  wide_legend
```

```{r sim_seasonal_cycle}
sim_seasonal_cycle <- sim |>
  _[,
    .(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(lon, lat, variable, month(time))
  ] |>
  _[, base := value[variable == "obs"], by = .(lon, lat, month)] |>
  _[variable != "obs"]
```


```{r fig-sim_seasonal_cycle}
#| fig-width: 9.385
#| fig-height: 10.563
#| label: bias-lonlat
range_tanaka
sim_seasonal_cycle |>
  _[month %in% c(2, 9)] |>
  ggperiodic::periodic(lon = c(0, 360)) |>
  _[, month := factor(month)] |>
  _[, variable := factor(variable)] |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_contour_fill(
    aes(z = value - base, fill = ..level..),
    proj = proj,
    breaks = AnchorBreaks(exclude = 0),
    proj.latlon = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_contour_tanaka(
    aes(z = value - base),
    smooth = 2,
    range = range_tanaka,
    proj = proj,
    breaks = AnchorBreaks(exclude = 0),
    proj.latlon = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_contour2(data = topo, aes(xgrid, ygrid, z = topo), breaks = 0) +
  scale_fill_divergent_discretised(
    "Sea-ice concentration bias",
    high = scales::muted("blue"),
    low = scales::muted("red")
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    month ~ variable,
    labeller = labeller(month = labeller_month, variable = labeller_sims)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  coord_equal() +
  wide_legend

```

```{r sim-cor}
cor_lonlat <- sim |>
  copy() |>
  _[, base := value[variable == "obs"], by = .(lon, lat, time)] |>
  _[variable != "obs"] |>
  na.omit() |>
  _[,
    cor(value, base, use = "complete.obs"),
    by = .(lon, lat, month(time), variable)
  ]
``` 

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9.385

cor_lonlat |>
```

```{r cell_area}
cell_area <- era_grid |>
  cdo_gridarea() |>
  cdo_execute() |>
  ReadNetCDF("cell_area") |>
  setnames(c("longitude", "latitude"), c("lon", "lat"))
```

```{r extent_aice}

extent_aice <- sim |>
  _[year(time) > 1981] |>
  _[value > 0.15] |>
  cell_area[i = _, on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[, .(mean_aice = sum(cell_area)), by = .(variable, time)] |>
  _[,
    mean_aice_a := mean_aice - mean(mean_aice, na.rm = TRUE),
    by = .(variable, month(time))
  ]
```

```{r extent_aice-plot}
#| fig-width: 31.535
#| fig-height: 6.823
#| label: extent-timeseries
area_cor <- extent_aice |>
  _[, base := mean_aice_a[variable == "obs"], by = .(time)] |>
  _[variable != "obs"] |>
  _[,
    .(cor = cor(mean_aice_a, base), rmse = sqrt(mean((mean_aice_a - base)^2))),
    by = variable
  ]

cor_text <- area_cor[, paste0(
  labeller_sims[variable],
  "=",
  scales::number(cor)
)] |>
  paste0(collapse = "\n")

rmse_text <- area_cor[, paste0(
  labeller_sims[variable],
  "=",
  scales::number(rmse / 1e12),
  "Mkm^2"
)] |>
  paste0(collapse = "\n")


extent_aice |>
  ggplot(aes(time, mean_aice_a / 1e12)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable), linewidth = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous("Mean sea-ice extent anomaly (M km^2)") +
  scale_x_datetime(
    NULL,
    expand = c(0, 0),
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%y"
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(
    NULL,
    palette = "Set1",
    labels = labeller_sims
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.text = element_text(size = rel(1)),
    legend.position.inside = c(0.90, 0.8)
  )
```


```{r}
area_cor |>
  copy() |>
  _[, variable := labeller_sims[variable]] |>
  melt(id.vars = "variable", variable.name = "measure") |>
  _[
    measure == "rmse",
    let(measure = "RMSE (M $km^2$)", value = value / 1e12)
  ] |>
  _[measure == "cor", let(measure = "Correlation")] |>
  dcast(measure ~ variable) |>
  setnames("measure", "") |>
  _[] |>
  xtable::xtable(digits = 2)
```
